summary: Dead Signal is a video game that follows what would happen if an astronaut was stranded on Mars. There are several events and structures. Events include dust storms, and radiation particle events. Structures include caves, ravines, craters, mountains, ravine cave entrances, and we recently added multiplayer. This game is aimed towards helping kids learn the real facts about space missions and Mars, and we made this game as realistic as possible, so that this game is fun to play and educational at the same time.
details: For this project, we originally created it on GDevelop, and then imported 3D models and did some 3D modeling on blender. The only SI usage was to finalize the graphics and make custom seeds each time. This game intent is to teach kids the real facts about Mars and make it fun, so this is why we added real NASA facts that will pop up in the corner of the screen every once in a while.
